Leaving an area

Lead your party to an available exit.

Check the travel map for destinations and routes back to camp. Some exits require quest progress.

Controls depend on your keyboard, gamepad and camera settings. The in-game guide shows your current bindings.

Classic edition reference

These original pages describe classic mouse and keyboard controls. Use the guidance above for current settings and gamepad controls.

Transfer areas

Transfer areas are special places and are marked in clouds of yellow particles in the Game zone (and yellow blocks on the mini-map). Use them to move from one Game zone to another. Since changing Game zones is an important step, you'll be asked to confirm when your character enters a Transfer area.

Your character is near the village right now. You've completed the quest and found the way to a human settlement. The only thing left for him to do is enter it - i.e. use a Transfer area.

If you are controlling several characters at the same time, your must get them all into the Transfer area to be able to use it. You cannot leave some of the characters in the Game zone and move others out of it.

Features

Each Transfer area in a particular Game zone is connected with a Transfer area in another Game zone.

Not all Transfer areas are immediately available. You may be unable access some of them. Areas which are currently unavailable will be clouds of red particles, rather than yellow.
